description: Annualized return (XIRR) for cash flows on specific dates, like Excel XIRR. Use this for real investments with irregular timing (capital calls, distributions, follow-ons); use irr only for evenly spaced yearly flows. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/xirr-calculator

cash_flows.description: Dated cash flows in any order. Negative amount = money invested, positive = money received or current value.

amount_usd.description: Amount in USD. Negative = invested, positive = received.

date.description: Date of the cash flow, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: xirr
title: XIRR calculator
